title: Machine-Learned Dynamical Representations for Accelerated RiteWeight Convergence
one_liner_zh: 该文比较了DeepTICA和SPIB-VAE等机器学习表示在加速RiteWeight轨迹重加权收敛中的效果，核心是蛋白质构象系综的动力学重加权计算，属于蛋白质结构相关的AI方法研究。
abstract: The increasing use of generative models has made ensembles of short molecular dynamics trajectories increasingly common, creating a growing need for methods that can recover physically meaningful steady-state populations and kinetics from improperly weighted conformational ensembles. Randomized Iterative Trajectory Reweighting (RiteWeight) addresses this problem through repeated random clustering and iterative reweighting, without requiring the fixed Markovian discretization used in conventional Markov state models (MSM). However, the choice of reduced feature space in which RiteWeight performs random clustering has not been systematically investigated. Here, we compare two machine-learned representations, DeepTICA and SPIB-VAE, with linear TICA for recovering steady-state observables from flawed distributions. DeepTICA learns nonlinear coordinates by targeting slow transfer-operator eigenmodes, whereas SPIB-VAE compresses configurations into a low-dimensional latent space while retaining information predictive of future metastable states. DeepTICA provided a comparatively robust RiteWeight representation under limited hyperparameter exploration, whereas SPIB-VAE benefited more strongly from broader optimization. Moreover, a kinetic score computed from a coarse MSM at a resolution comparable to that used for RiteWeight random clustering provided a useful criterion for efficiently selecting reduced representations and their hyperparameters for RiteWeight.
abstract_zh: 生成模型日益广泛的应用使得短分子动力学轨迹集合愈发常见，这催生了对能够从不正确加权的构象系综中恢复具有物理意义的稳态群体和动力学的方法的需求。随机迭代轨迹重加权（RiteWeight）通过重复随机聚类和迭代重加权来解决这一问题，无需传统马尔可夫状态模型（MSM）中使用的固定马尔可夫离散化。然而，RiteWeight 执行随机聚类时所采用的约化特征空间的选择尚未得到系统研究。在此，我们比较了两种机器学习表示方法，即 DeepTICA 和 SPIB-VAE，与线性 TICA 在从有缺陷分布中恢复稳态可观测量方面的表现。DeepTICA 通过靶向慢传递算子本征模式来学习非线性坐标，而 SPIB-VAE 则将构象压缩到低维潜在空间，同时保留预测未来亚稳态状态的信息。在有限的超参数探索下，DeepTICA 为 RiteWeight 提供了相对稳健的表示，而 SPIB-VAE 则更受益于更广泛的优化。此外，从与 RiteWeight 随机聚类分辨率相当的粗粒度 MSM 计算得到的动力学评分，为高效选择 RiteWeight 的约化表示及其超参数提供了有用标准。
